sourceTransform.note: Exact PIN1.27 manufacturer STL cover and every nonduplicate solid of its directly linked Stamp-S3 STEP use native mm coordinates, global Z shift -1.3 mm and no scale. One copper standoff and CHS-M2X3 screw retained. Official socket footprint identifies 17+11 standard KiCad 1.27 mm headers and row centers; standalone downward orientation and seating are photo-informed. The socket fixture and its 3D offsets are not misrepresented as the standalone module assembly.

omittedComponents.reason: Alternative full shield from the STEP is superseded by the separately published exact STL cover; importing both would overlap. All other 28 STEP solids retain their native positions.

The receiving 1x17/1x11 female sockets belong to the optional mating socket fixture, not this standalone PIN1.27 module. Footprint model z offsets are fixture assembly coordinates; actual module header orientation is checked against exact-SKU photos.

buttons.notes: Conservative interior of the connected shield flexure cap; CAD top plane 2.35 mm, hit plane +0.02 mm. No deformation or new physical cap.

inspectionGroups.notes: Orange cover, retained M2 screw, visual socket mark and G0 cover hit surface move along local +Z by 10 mm for inspection. Source PCB, standoff, USB, antenna and soldered pin headers remain assembled. This is a viewing offset, not a measured disassembly path.

derivedParts.label: UNKNOWN
derivedParts.notes: Small annotation above actual PCB component-side plane; no second board. Manufacturer mechanical outline is known, but populated internal component layout is not. Outward underside has official photo; inward marker can be inspected with shield hidden or translucent.

Single WS2812B-2020 package location estimated from the bare-board official photograph using 18 mm board width. Package height/placement not measured CAD; retained shield can occlude it, no invented window or light pipe.

Photo-informed dark hexagonal indication on the native screw head; original STEP screw solid is retained unchanged. The source CAD omits the socket recess, so this surface is appearance only, not a modeled machined cavity or fit claim.

Supplemental visible back-side flange on the retained source standoff. Exact-SKU underside photo shows a wider annular lip than source CAD; estimated outer diameter 3.9 mm, hole diameter 1.84 mm and thickness .14 mm. Position follows native source standoff; radial uncertainty ±.3 mm and thickness unmeasured. This is explicit photo-informed appearance geometry, not manufacturer manufacturing CAD.

textures.mapping: Exact PIN1.27 backside photo on actual source PCB back plane. Back-view X mirror preserved; copper standoff and both elevated headers excluded from flat photo layer. Original CAD holes/edges bound the texture.
textures.uncertainty: Oblique 800x800 image; board source footprint about 300x420 pixels. Corner projection and perspective depth are uncertain by roughly 0.8 mm; no independent populated-layout certification. Solder/header raised detail is modeled separately or excluded.
textures.method: Four explicit original-image film corners rectified by OpenCV getPerspectiveTransform/warpPerspective (Lanczos4); original-coordinate alpha ROI and hardware exclusions applied before warp. Original pixels only; projection uncertainty recorded, not independent geometry verification.

sources.notes: Uses socket fixture coordinates; header offsets are converted relative to its Stamp-S3 model offset, and sockets are excluded from standalone product.

limitations: Manufacturer cover/PCB mechanical/USB/antenna/standoff/screw geometry is retained unchanged. The model remains partial; populated electronics and exact surface finishes are incomplete.

The official PIN1.27 socket footprint proves 17+11 pin count, 1.27 mm pitch and row locations. Retained KiCad standard header geometry is not measured factory CAD; standalone orientation/seating follows exact-SKU photographs and excludes receiving sockets.
Header plastic is 1 mm high with a 3 mm long mating section from the KiCad standard library. Actual contact tolerances and solder profile are unverified; no claim of physical fit.
A photo-informed 3.9 mm annular back flange supplements the native standoff, whose back profile is simplified. Its .14 mm thickness is an appearance estimate, not measured hardware.

Black PCB backside is covered by a masked rectified exact-SKU official image; inward UNKNOWN remains on the real board face and is readable through declared inspection. Photo projection does not certify trace connectivity or component heights.
Original linked bare-module photographs are oblique 800x800; no orthographic contour precision pass is claimed. Packaging reference is 1200x1200 and does not increase PCB pixel detail.
The supplied pin sticker is loose in the documented package and not applied in the default photographed orange-cover assembly. No floating sticker is added.
Official specification says 26x18x4.6 mm; shared drawing body is 24x18x4.7 mm. Installed pins extend beyond the body; these scopes and thickness discrepancy stay explicit.
Source screw head has a photo-informed hex visual mark, not a machined socket. USB/copper plating/fastener details remain simplified, and shallow cover embossing depends on lighting.
Model validation does not establish guest firmware behavior; runtime evidence is maintained separately.
